title: eval-harness: add per-prompt metrics CI hooks with regression gating and GitHub check annotations
author: Lena Park
commits: feat(eval-harness): add per-prompt metric hooks and output formatter
test(eval-harness): add unit tests for metric thresholds and annotation parsing
chore(ci): wire new eval-harness step into .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml
fix(eval-harness): handle empty prompt buckets to avoid division by zero in gating
description: Add a CI hook for the eval-harness that emits per-prompt metrics and enforces prompt-set regression gates. Motivation: recent regressions were masked by aggregated metrics (ENG-4821). This change extends the existing eval CI to produce per-prompt precision/recall/f1 and a small summary JSON, posts GitHub check annotations for the top regressions, and fails the check when any prompt-level metric drops beyond configured thresholds. The description includes: - Backwards-compatible agents: existing aggregated gating remains the default; new per_prompt gating is opt-in via .evalci/config.yaml - Configurable thresholds: per-prompt absolute and relative drop thresholds, whitelist/blacklist for prompt groups - Annotations: top 10 worst regressions are surfaced as GitHub check annotations with links to the failing prompt and example outputs - Observability: metrics are emitted to the internal eval-metrics ingestion endpoint for downstream dashboarding and alerts - Tests: unit tests for threshold logic and integration test that runs a small synthetic eval set in CI Checklist: - [x] implement per-prompt hook and formatter - [x] add unit + integration tests - [x] update eval CI workflow - [x] docs: add short how-to for maintainers on enabling per-prompt gating Risks & mitigations: initial run produced transient failures due to NaN when a prompt had zero examples; added guard and test. Rollout plan: enable opt-in on canary repo for 2 weeks, then flip default across repos. Related: ENG-4821, SUP-903.
review_comments: Aisha Khan: Can we add a flag to limit the number of annotations posted? GitHub checks can get noisy.
Author (Lena Park): Added max_annotations option in config and capped to 10 in the hook. Also added tests for behavior.
Miguel Ortega: Tests look good, please add a small integration smoke test in the CI workflow so we don't regress the step.
Author (Lena Park): Added a lightweight integration job that runs against a tiny synthetic prompt set; CI now includes that job.
Samir Patel: Approving after the integration smoke test and docs update. Observability team notified about new metric names.
release_notes: Add per-prompt eval CI gating and GitHub annotations. Opt-in via evalci config; guardrails included to limit noise.
